selection_rule: For each true object predicate and camera, choose min/max red-object pixel visibility among sampled configurations with no negative-distance contact involving moving robot; static configurations only.
limitations: No task execution or collision-free connecting motion was tested.
Object states were reset directly, not reached by a policy.
No reward-model scores, false completion or optimization exploitation was measured.
Same object state does not imply same future action value; only current stable-placement predicate is fixed.
Geometric visibility change alone is not evidence of model failure or method novelty.
